Routing

How the router chooses a model, and how to read why it chose that one.

A request without a model is routed by the key's rules. The rules are policy data in packs: a task class, a data class, a consequence class and a price ceiling narrow the candidates, and the router picks among those left. A caller may state the classes in the headers X-MassRelay-Task-Class, X-MassRelay-Data-Class and X-MassRelay-Consequence-Class. A class the key's lane cannot enforce is refused with a 400 rather than ignored.

Explain on every call

Every answer carries a decision id. GET /v1/route/explain/{decisionId} returns the rationale, the task class and where it came from, the chosen model and tier, the effort, and the models that were excluded with the reason for each. A decision of another workspace is a 404, the same as an unknown id.

GET /v1/route/explain/{decisionId}

Who may call: relay key (bearer).

Path parameters: decisionId.

Response schema

{
  "description": "Hand-written, read against explain_for_key in crates/mr-gateway/src/decisions.rs (the GatewayExplainDto plus the MC-1b/RT-2 additions). 404 decision_not_found for an unknown id or another workspace's id. The `explain` scope is required on the key.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "decisionId",
    "rationale",
    "taskClass",
    "chosenTier",
    "createdAt"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "decisionId": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "rationale": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Rendered from rationaleTemplateId."
    },
    "rationaleTemplateId": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "taskClass": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "classSource": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "chosenModel": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "chosenTier": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "effort": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "borrowLevel": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "createdAt": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "catalogVersion": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "dataClass": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "consequenceClass": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "intentSource": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "excluded": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "model": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "reason": {},
          "policies": {
            "type": "array"
          },
          "detail": {}
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

The policy door

GET /v1/policy authenticates the key and today answers 501 not_ported: it returns no policy document yet. The reference states its body so a caller does not expect more.

Virtual models

A named model id that is a per-request route over real candidates, and a clamp of a requested thinking level to the nearest supported one, are coming (ROUTE-VM-1 and ROUTE-TL-1).
